title: UI Developer | Chennai, Tamil Nadu, INDIA
description:
Purchasing Power is a leading employee purchase program that helps people buy the products and services they need through the convenience of payroll deduction. As part of PROG Holdings (NYSE: PRG), a FinTech holding company with more than 20 years of experience, we’re focused on building simple, responsible financial solutions that put people first. PROG Holdings’ portfolio includes Progressive Leasing, a market leader in lease‑to‑own solutions, Purchasing Power, and Four, a Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) platform — all united by a commitment to innovation, access, and meaningful impact.
  
  
**Position**
: UI Developer
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai, Tamil Nadu, INDIA
  
  
**Who Are We:**
Purchasing Power (corp.purchasingpower.com)
  
  
We are an Atlanta-based voluntary benefit company offering an industry-leading employee purchase program for brand-name consumer products, online education services and travel offerings through convenient payroll deduction, helping employees achieve financial flexibility.
  
  
**The Opportunity:**
Purchasing Power is looking for an individual with strong experience with UI development. Working in an enterprise environment building our next generation B2B eCommerce platform. In this UI Developer position, working on a team of software engineers that are building the best possible eCommerce application for our B2B2C customers. You’ll work closely with our IT team (Development/ PMO/ Infrastructure/ Product), business stakeholders and other partners to implement new solutions. In this role you will be partnering with other hardworking engineering minds across the company working on some of the coolest technologies. If you have a passion for quality and a keen eye for details this will be a great fit. You will also enjoy the benefits of working in a fast-growing business where you are encouraged to "Think Different" and where your efforts play a key role in the success of Purchasing Power business.
  
  
**Key Qualifications Must Have**

* Strong knowledge in front end technologies involving-
* React and/or Angular
* JavaScript o jQuery
* AJAX
* HTML
* CSS
* Bootstrap
* Hands on experience in designing and developing large scale applications using front end Web Technologies
* Good interpersonal, listening, verbal, and written communication skills
* Understanding of component and module style
* Ability to take designs and determine the best way to implement changes or pages from the ground up
* Git knowledge and comfort with git style committing
* Understanding of the website data cycle; data travels across systems

**Nice To Have**

* Experience with the build & deployment processes with Jenkins, code quality
* knowledge in Object-oriented programming (OOP) concepts and Java
* Work under aggressive schedules and with multi-functional teams to achieve large initiatives
* Understanding of eCommerce and business-to-business (B2B) systems, preferably Hybris
* Experience with automated testing methodologies and frameworks

**Description**

* Analyzing user stories and requirements to determine if enough level of detail is provided. If not, drive conversations to detail out the full requirement
* Map these requirements to our existing eCommerce solution to determine whether they can be achieved through "out of the box" capabilities or if customizations are needed
* Drive documentation of technical design and architecture of the system
* Collaborate with onsite and offshore developers/engineers regarding what should be included in the software packaged application, or product to ensure it is included for roll-out/implementation
* Reviews application architecture and design, development and maintenance programming work you're doing, technology tools, and associated technology process for application systems, including coordinated software and hardware application configurations.
* Key contributions to the development and delivery of systems; help shape system requirements, and develop analysis-level documents that reflect the requirements
* Work with multi-functional team for integrations and data needs
* Improves and carries out coding standards and follows CI/CD process
* Write software and participate in code reviews in debugging and coding to problem solve
* Develop prototypes and POCs to demonstrate new ideas or illustrate the use of new technologies and how to apply it into our systems
* Own and review work for accuracy, quality, application performance and completeness
* Keep up to date with the latest technologies and tools and evangelize their value within the development teams
* Strive for top quality results and continuously look for ways to improve and enhance system reliability, performance, and security
* We're looking for a hardworking and passionate person to join this amazing team, if you feel this is you, we'd love to hear from you

**Education & Experience**

* Masters or Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science / Software Engineering / Related field with a minimum of 4-6 years technical experience in meaningful areas.

**What We Stand For**

* We act with intensity, urgency and a passion for supporting our customers and growing our business. We strive for excellence.
* We hold ourselves accountable and expect it of each other. We attack problems with a positive “can do” attitude. We do what we say we’ll do.
* We deliver as one team, working together with integrity, respect, trust, transparency, and fun. We are better because we work here.
* We believe our unique diversity and authenticity makes us a better company, allows us to be our best selves and is a competitive advantage.
* We exhibit innate curiosity and creativity to innovate and reimagine how things can be done. We ask, is there a better way.

**How To Apply**
Interested and qualified candidates are encouraged to submit their updated resume directly to the email address:
**hrindia@purchasingpower.com**
Please include the
**position title in the subject line**
of your email.
  
  
*Purchasing Power welcomes and encourages diversity in the workplace. We do not discriminate in any aspect of employment on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, age, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local employment discrimination laws where Purchasing Power does business.*

title: Software Development Engineer
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**
We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
  
  
**About The Team**
VNDLY, a Workday company, is a next-generation vendor management SaaS platform designed for procurement executives, talent acquisition teams, suppliers, and Managed Service Providers (MSPs) to optimize contingent workforce management. We develop cloud software that simplifies talent sourcing and acquisition across various channels, including staffing agencies, job boards, and freelance management systems. Our aim is to create intuitive software that enables customers to efficiently acquire top talent (contractors or full-time employees) through data-driven insights and transparent dashboards.
  
  
As part of Workday, we are committed to becoming the most customer-centric enterprise software company in the world. We prioritize enabling our customers to connect to the talent they need to excel, achieved by fostering an exceptional engineering team committed to code quality and innovative design.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Software Development Engineer, you will be joining a team in Chennai responsible for maintaining and building our pay-related features. This is a hands-on-keyboard role where you will not only build features but also own the design, scalability, and resilience of critical services.
  
  
You will tackle complex challenges related to how contingent workers are onboarded, managed, and paid, working on key features like Jobs, Worker Provisioning, Contracts, and Integrations. You will be a key voice in our architectural decisions and will guide the team in building robust solutions using our stack: Python (backend), React (frontend), and AWS.
  
  
**About You**
This role is for an experienced engineer who enjoys solving complex software problems. The ideal candidate will join an established office of 15 VNDLY colleagues and will be at the forefront of building our engineering presence as part of Workday's larger investment in Chennai!
  
  
Beyond a desire for solving complex and writing high-quality, efficient code, this person must be an exceptional communicator, acting as a key technical connection between our established U.S. teams and the new Chennai office. The ability to work independently, while also working effectively within a large, distributed team, is essential.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 4+ years shown experience in software development, including experience in designing, building, and maintaining RESTful web services and working with SQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL).
* Deep proficiency in Python and experience with at least one Python web framework (e.g., Django, Flask).
* Strong experience with JavaScript frameworks, specifically React.js.

**Other Qualifications**

* Proficient understanding of code versioning tools (e.g., Git).
* Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) (e.g., EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda).
* Knowledge of SaaS applications, multi-tenant architectures, and DevOps/CI/CD practices.
* Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development environment.

Workday is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.
  
  
Further, pursuant to applicable local ordinances, Workday will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
  
  
You may view the Workday's Pay Transparency Policy, and Equal Employment Opportunity is the Law notice, by clicking on their corresponding links.
  
  
Workday is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans during our application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, contact us at accommodations@workday.com.
  
  
**Our Approach to Flexible Work**
With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply
**spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field**
with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.
  
  
Workday is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals during our application process, in order to perform one or more essential functions of their job, as well as regarding the use of AI tools for employment decision-making to any degree. Please see below for more details including how to request an accommodation as a qualified veteran, due to a disability or for religious reasons, or as otherwise provided under applicable law.
  
  
Workday prohibits taking adverse action against any candidate or employee for reporting a possible violation of this policy, requesting one or more work accommodations, exercising a privacy right, or cooperating in an investigation in accordance with applicable law. Any employee who retaliates against a candidate or employee for doing so may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment, to the fullest extent allowable under applicable law.
  
  
If you require a reasonable accommodation, you may email accommodations@workday.com, as far in advance as possible.
  
  
**Are you being referred to one of our roles? If so, ask your connection at Workday about our Employee Referral process!**
At Workday, we value our candidates’ privacy and data security. Workday will never ask candidates to apply to jobs through websites that are not Workday Careers.
  
  
Please be aware of sites that may ask for you to input your data in connection with a job posting that appears to be from Workday but is not.
  
  
In addition, Workday will never ask candidates to pay a recruiting fee, or pay for consulting or coaching services, in order to apply for a job at Workday.

title: Senior Lead Engineer – React Native (Mobile Apps)
description:
We’re looking for a Senior Lead Engineer – React Native with deep experience designing and building scalable, high-performance mobile applications using React Native, TypeScript, Expo, and modern mobile architecture patterns. This role will play a critical part in shaping the technical direction of our mobile platform, driving architecture decisions, optimizing performance, and delivering enterprise-grade mobile experiences.
  
  
You’ll work closely with Engineering, Product, Design, Backend, and DevOps teams to build highly responsive, secure, and maintainable iOS and Android applications. We’re seeking someone who can operate strategically while remaining hands-on — someone who enjoys solving complex mobile challenges while influencing long-term platform evolution.
  
  
  
What You’ll Be Doing
  
· Provide technical leadership and oversee the daily mobile engineering operations.
  
· Define and drive the mobile architecture strategy aligned with business goals.
  
· Lead the design and development of scalable, high-performance mobile applications using React Native and TypeScript.
  
· Architect modular, reusable component systems and scalable state management solutions (Redux, Zustand, Context API, etc.).
  
· Design clean navigation, deep linking, and mobile routing strategies (React Navigation, Expo Router).
  
· Implement secure authentication flows (OAuth/OIDC, biometrics, secure storage, token lifecycle management).
  
· Drive native module integrations (Swift, Kotlin) for SDKs such as payments, fraud detection, analytics, push notifications, and device security.
  
· Optimize mobile performance (startup time, bundle size, memory usage, rendering performance, offline caching).
  
· Establish CI/CD pipelines for mobile (Fastlane, EAS Build, App Store Connect, Google Play Console).
  
· Lead app release management, versioning strategy, and store compliance.
  
· Ensure adherence to mobile security best practices, privacy compliance, and accessibility standards.
  
· Partner with backend teams to define API contracts and optimize mobile-backend interactions.
  
· Champion automated testing (Jest, React Native Testing Library, Detox) and code quality standards.
  
· Mentor engineers and foster a culture of ownership, craftsmanship, and continuous improvement.
  
· Participate in architecture reviews and roadmap planning for long-term mobile platform scalability.
  
  
What You Bring to the Table
  
· Strong hands-on experience building production-grade apps using React Native and TypeScript.
  
· Deep understanding of Expo ecosystem (EAS, OTA updates, build pipelines, native configuration).
  
· Expertise in mobile architecture patterns (Clean Architecture, MVVM, modular architecture).
  
· Experience integrating native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) modules into React Native apps.
  
· Strong understanding of app lifecycle, memory management, threading, and performance tuning.
  
· Experience implementing push notifications, deep linking, analytics SDKs, and mobile security frameworks.
  
· Familiarity with authentication flows (OIDC, PKCE, secure token handling).
  
· Experience with API integrations (REST, GraphQL) and handling network resiliency/offline-first design.
  
· Strong understanding of mobile DevOps, CI/CD, and release governance.
  
· Experience collaborating in Agile environments and influencing cross-functional stakeholders.
  
· Ability to balance hands-on development with strategic architectural leadership.
  
  
  
Requirements
  
  
Basic Qualifications
  
· Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  
· 10+ years of software development experience.
  
· 6+ years of hands-on mobile development experience.
  
· 4+ years leading React Native applications in production environments.
  
· Proven experience delivering apps to both Apple App Store and Google Play Store.
  
· Experience working with cloud-based backends (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
  
· Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and DevOps best practices.
  
· Demonstrated leadership experience mentoring engineers and guiding technical direction.
  
· Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to make strategic architectural decisions balancing business and technical needs.

We are hiring Forward Deployed Engineers who treat AI as the substrate of how software gets built not a tool to be cautious of, not something they are "exploring," but the medium they work in.
  
  
You will sit close to clients and product leaders, reframe vague problems into something concrete, and ship working software end-to-end. You won't wait for a refined backlog, a PM in the middle, or a separate platform team. You will shape the idea, build the thing, and stand it up in production yourself.
  
  
This is a builder-first individual-contributor role for engineers who live at the current edge of AI development and work fluently with Claude Code, Cursor, agents, eval harnesses, MCP, and modern TypeScript and Python.
  
  
**What You Ll Do**
**Problem / Opportunity Discovery**

* Sit with a business or clinical leader and reframe an idea or problem into something concrete and buildable.
* Know what to build by the end of the conversation; have a working prototype to react to by the end of the week.
* Partner closely with product, design, and client stakeholders to translate ambiguous ideas into software that ships.
* Demo live without a slide deck. Reframe problems out loud. Don't get stuck waiting for someone else to make the decision.
* Lead POCs, innovation sprints, and internal research experiments to validate emerging AI techniques.

**Build (fast) with AI**

* When the brief is clear, head down and produce.
* Build modular backends in Python or TypeScript aligned with clean architecture, OOP, SOLID, and domain-driven design.
* Create fullstack applications, APIs, agents, workflows, and similar systems using frameworks such as Next.js, React, FastAPI, Fastify, FastMCP, and Hono.
* Architect and ship production-grade agentic applications using LangGraph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants, or your own orchestration layer.
* Integrate frontier and self-hosted LLMs (Claude, GPT, Gemini, open-weight models) with tools, data, and external systems through MCP and custom connectors.
* Apply RAG techniques where they actually help: vector databases (Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, pgvector), hybrid retrieval with ElasticSearch or Solr, and BM25 + similarity search.
* Work across relational, document, key-value, and graph stores as the problem demands; use event-driven patterns where they fit, not by default.
* Design prompt and context engineering frameworks that optimize accuracy, repeatability, cost, and latency.
* Use AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codex) through structured workflows, native instructions, templates, and sub-agents with discipline and review.
* Fine-tune or adapt models where the problem genuinely calls for it.

**Test, Deploy, Productionize**

* Spin up the infra, write the evals, wire up the MCP servers, deploy the agents, and harden the bits that survive contact with real users.
* Deploy on AWS, Azure, Cloudflare, or Vercel using containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) or serverless chosen for fit, not preference.
* Treat evals as a first-class discipline: hands-on harnesses, not theoretical frameworks. Build with a clear-eyed view of where current AI tooling helps and where it falls short.
* Apply engineering practices that hold up in production: TDD, secrets management and rotation, SAST/DAST, structured logging, metrics, tracing, and automated CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins).
* Own what you build end-to-end, including the infrastructure and operations that keep it running.
* Mentor others on system design, agentic patterns, and AI engineering best practices.

**What You Bring**

* 3+ years relevant experience building production applications using AI / agentic development approaches fullstack applications, agents, workflows, MCPs, and more.
* Hands-on experience with agents, not just prompted models. You have wired tools to a model and let it run multi-step using LangGraph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants, or your own orchestration.
* Active, structured use of AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) with demonstrable workflows, sub-agents, skills, and innovative approaches.
* Strong Python or TypeScript, with OOP, SOLID, 12-factor application development, and microservice architecture. You've built Next.js applications, FastAPI services, and similar.
* End-to-end implementation experience with vector databases, retrieval pipelines, and eval harnesses.
* Cloud-native deployment experience across at least one of AWS, Azure, Cloudflare, or Vercel with Docker, Kubernetes, and GitHub Actions.
* A no-compromise attitude on clean code, TDD, security, observability, scalability, performance, and cost.
* A deep working understanding of how LLMs behave and where they break and how to optimize accuracy, latency, and cost.
* Clear writing and a willingness to reframe problems in conversation rather than wait for someone else to define them.
* A real, recent trail of built things: GitHub, a portfolio, side projects, indie tools, or OSS contributions.
* A founder's mindset and genuine appetite for ambiguous, high-impact technical challenges.
* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related technical discipline.

**Bonus Skills / Experience**

* Public writing, talks, or threads about building with AI.
* MLOps and model serving experience (BentoML, MLflow, Vertex AI, SageMaker).
* Streaming and batch ingestion pipelines (Spark, Airflow, Beam, Glue).
* Healthcare or life sciences domain exposure.
* AWS Professional certification or other relevant industry certifications.

**What We Offer**
At Newpage, we re building a company that works smart and grows with agility, where driven individuals come together to do work that matters. We offer:
  
  

* A people-first culture - Supportive peers, open communication and a strong sense of belonging
* Smart, purposeful collaboration - Work with talented colleagues to create technologies that solve meaningful business challenges
* Balance that lasts - We respect your time and support a healthy integration of work and life
* Room to grow - Opportunities for learning, leadership and career development, shaped around you
* Meaningful rewards - Competitive compensation that recognises both contribution and potential

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About DevRev**
At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
*Computer*
– your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
*Computer*
unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at DevRev, you will work closely with our pre- and post-sales Customer Experience team by developing solutions over the core platform via applications written in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, etc. One of the key functions of this role is, building the Knowledge Graph that includes integration of DevRev with other SaaS and non-SaaS systems through webhooks and APIs and/ or real-time communication architectures. You will be expected to employ your creativity and expertise to ideate and shape how AI, analytics and workflows are used in customers' processes.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Customer-facing: 30% working directly with customers.
* Coding & Integration: 70-80% hands-on technical implementation
* Build & Deploy Solutions: Design, develop, and launch AI agents, integrations, and automations that connect DevRev with customers' existing tech stacks and workflows.
* Integrate Systems: Connect DevRev with SaaS and non-SaaS platforms through APIs, webhooks, and real-time communication architectures for seamless data flow.
* Optimize AI Performance: Apply prompt engineering, fine-tune semantic search engines, and leverage generative AI techniques to enhance agent accuracy and user experience.
* Own Data Insights: Write SQL queries, perform data analysis, and build dashboards to surface insights that drive customer decision-making.
* Prototype & Iterate: Develop rapid proofs-of-concept, conduct live technical demos, and refine solutions based on customer and stakeholder feedback.
* Lead Cross-functional Collaboration: Maintain constant communication loops with customers, engineering, product, customer success, support, and revenue teams to ensure alignment.
* Guide Technical Adoption: Learn and master new tools, then guide customers through critical workflows like code repository integrations and advanced configurations.
* Travel Ready: Willingness to travel up to 30% for on-site implementations, technical workshops, and customer engagements.

**What You Bring**

* Experience: 5+ years in software development, systems integration, or platform engineering. Customer-facing experience is a plus.
* Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Coding Skills: Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms. (Nice to have: Go)
* Applied AI Knowledge: Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions.
* Integration Expertise: Deep experience with large-scale data synchronization (one-way and two-way), API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, webhooks), and event-driven/pub/sub architectures.
* Cloud & Deployment: Hands-on experience deploying on serverless and edge platforms (AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions) with modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, observability).
* Data Transformation: Skilled in data mapping, schema alignment, and working with heterogeneous systems. Understanding of data modeling and graph data structures.
* Observability: Experience implementing clear logging, actionable error surfacing, and telemetry to support faster debugging and issue resolution.
* Context-Aware Systems: Familiarity with Model Context Programming (MCP) for building adaptive, context-aware integrations.
* Problem-Solving: Strong track record triaging and unblocking both technical and non-technical blockers to keep projects moving forward.
* Documentation: Experience writing concise, well-structured documentation that supports long-term team understanding and seamless onboarding.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal skills to articulate technical concepts to engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders.

As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV.
  
  
**How do we work?**
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.
  
  
That’s DevRev!
  
  
*DevRev is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.*

description:

Amazon.com is looking for a talented and enthusiastic Senior Software Development Engineer to join the Digital Content Platform team. The Digital Acceleration Commerce team owns services supporting the publishing, pricing and purchase of Digital content, including Kindle Books, Amazon AppStore, Amazon Music, Amazon Video, etc.
  
  
This candidate will be joining a team working on scalable web services using cloud technologies. The work will be highly visible to Amazon customers and internal stakeholders.
  
  
As a Senior Software Development Engineer, this person will lead the architecture and development of high-scale web services and workflows. A successful candidate will have an established background in designing and developing back-end web services, strong technical skills, a motivation to achieve results in a fast-paced environment, high creativity, and great analytical reasoning skills.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As a Software Development Engineer III (SDE3) on the Digital Pricing and Promotions team, you will design and build software solutions that power promotional capabilities across Amazon's Digital Acceleration (DA) businesses — including Kindle, Prime Video, and Music. You will own and evolve critical platforms that deliver promotional management, competitive pricing intelligence, and operational automation to pricing managers, business teams, and product managers across DA.
  
  
You will take meaningful ownership of key products — particularly the Promos UI platform — driving features from initial design through deployment and ongoing maintenance. Your work will span full-stack development: crafting user interfaces with modern web technologies, building robust backend services in Java on AWS, and integrating with Retail promotion systems such as PLM (Promotion Lifecycle Management).
  
  
In this role, you will make architectural decisions that balance near-term business needs with long-term scalability and maintainability. You will think across systems — considering performance at scale, multi-business extensibility, and integration with diverse data sources and downstream services. You will lead technical designs independently, engage actively in design reviews, and provide substantive code review feedback that raises the bar for the team.
  
  
Collaboration is central to this role. You will work closely with operations teams, business stakeholders, Retail promotion platform teams, and partner engineering organizations. You will develop a deep understanding of customer workflows and pain points, translating them into well-designed, reliable solutions. You will champion operational excellence through proactive monitoring, incident response, and identifying opportunities for automation and process improvement.
  
  
Beyond individual delivery, you will help grow the team — mentoring junior engineers, contributing to development best practices, and driving technical improvements that increase the team's overall velocity and reliability. Success in this role means consistently shipping high-quality features that advance our promotional capabilities while setting a strong example for engineering craft and customer focus.

* 7+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 7+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 7+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Technical Anchor, Software Engineering
description:
As a Technical Anchor, you will oversee the technical design, development, and delivery of business-critical applications and high-throughput data platforms. You will establish engineering excellence across full-stack systems, architect resilient Java-based microservices, deliver responsive front-end data exploration interfaces using React or Angular, and design enterprise-grade cloud data streaming and analytical pipelines on GCP. You will lead distributed engineering squads across local and global locations, driving cloud modernization, data governance, and operational reliability to fuel Ford’s digital transformation.
  
  

* Technical Leadership, Architecture & Modernization
* Anchor Technical Delivery: Act as the primary technical anchor, translating complex business requirements from legacy applications in GDIA into scalable, fault-tolerant system designs, architectural blueprints, and execution roadmaps.
* Architecture Standards: Drive the evolution of Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA), cloud-native microservices, and event-driven patterns. Establish coding standards, API contracts (OpenAPI/Swagger), and architectural governance across squads.
* Legacy System Modernization: Lead legacy modernization initiatives by re-architecting monolithic services into modular, containerized workloads on GCP, engineering continuous ingestion flows from heterogeneous enterprise platforms.
* Engineering Mentorship & SDLC Excellence: Champion agile engineering best practices, enforce test-driven development (TDD), lead comprehensive code reviews, and mentor engineers across full-stack, data engineering, and cloud domains.
* Full-Stack & Microservices Engineering
* Backend Services: Architect and develop robust, high-performance microservices and RESTful APIs using Java 17+, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and supporting synchronous transactions and asynchronous event-driven flows.
* Frontend & Data Visualization: Build responsive, user-centric interfaces using Angular, React, and Node.js that integrate seamlessly with backend APIs to deliver intuitive self-service data access, reporting, and interactive data visualization.
* API Gateway & Service Mesh: Design and standardize API gateway topologies using Apigee; enforce service discovery, circuit breakers, rate limiting, and resilient inter-service communication.
* Performance Engineering & Optimization: Profile and optimize distributed systems end-to-end, including JVM tuning, connection pooling, caching strategies, and database query tuning across relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL datastores.
* Cloud Data Engineering & Analytics
* Scalable Data Pipelines: Architect, build, and maintain real-time streaming and high-volume batch data pipelines leveraging GCP Dataflow (Apache Beam), Dataproc (Spark/Hadoop), and Cloud Pub/Sub.
* Modern Data Warehousing: Standardize, model, partition, and optimize enterprise datasets within Google BigQuery to ensure exceptional SQL query performance, cost efficiency, and real-time analytical capabilities.
* Security, Governance & Compliance
* Zero Trust Security: Enforce least-privileged access control across applications, integrating Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), ADFS, OAuth2/OIDC, and method-level access authorization.
* Cloud & Data Governance: Implement robust cloud security frameworks, including Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), data encryption (in transit and at rest), data masking, and GCP-native row-level and column-level security.
* Regulatory Compliance: Partner with cybersecurity, compliance, and governance teams to maintain adherence to enterprise data privacy mandates and corporate security standards.
* DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure & Observability
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Automate and manage repeatable cloud infrastructure and platform provisioning using Terraform.
* CI/CD Automation: Design and optimize enterprise CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Tekton, and build automation tools (Maven, Gradle) for automated testing, static code analysis, and zero-downtime deployments.
* Operational Reliability & Telemetry: Establish proactive monitoring, tracing, and alerting frameworks across Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Cloud Run, and Cloud Functions to diagnose distributed system bottlenecks and ensure platform health.
* AI/ML Innovation: Apply foundational AI and Machine Learning (ML) concepts, including Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs), to accelerate engineering workflows and enhance software capabilities.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience).
* Professional Experience: 10+ years of progressive software engineering experience delivering enterprise-scale solutions across full-stack development, distributed computing, and data platforms. Core Technical Competencies:
* Backend Engineering: Deep expertise in Java (Java 17+), Spring Ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Data, Spring Security), and scripting proficiency.
* Frontend Engineering: Hands-on experience developing data visualization and exploration interfaces using React, Angular, or Node.js.
* GCP Cloud Platforms: Proven track record architecting and deploying systems on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), specifically BigQuery, Cloud Run, GKE and Cloud Pub/Sub.
* Database Systems: Strong practical expertise with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL), NoSQL datastores, and columnar analytical warehouses.
* DevOps & IaC: Hands-on mastery of Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and automated CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Tekton, Maven/Gradle).
* API & Testing Standards: Deep knowledge of RESTful API design (OpenAPI/Swagger) paired with a test-driven mindset using JUnit and Mockito

description:

**Ciklum**
is looking for a
**Senior JavaScript Engineer**
to join our team full-time in India.
  
  
We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Senior JavaScript Engineer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow. Together, we will work on the project Phase 2 Customer Expansion: Design, build, and deploy the next-generation, customer-facing RemitIntel Application.

* Code Quality & Governance: Lead the pull-request process and code reviews to maintain low bug rates and ensure production-grade reliability
* System Lifecycle Management: Manage the full application lifecycle, from initial requirements analysis and debugging to deployment and continuous refactoring
* Agile Integration: Drive delivery within an Agile/SCRUM framework, providing transparent task updates and ensuring alignment between onshore and offshore teams
* Cross-Border Collaboration: Maintain high-touch communication with US counterparts, including staggered shift availability (2pm–11pm) during critical design and delivery phases

**Requirements**

* Frontend Expertise: 6+ years of hands-on experience with JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, and CSS3, with a minimum of 2 years dedicated to TypeScript
* Angular Mastery: 2+ years of experience with Angular 11+ component architecture, including directives, pipes, and migration strategies to newer versions
* Advanced State & Logic: Proficiency in RxJS operators and state management libraries such as NgXs
* Monorepo & Tooling: Proven experience with Nx (Nrwl) for monorepo management and proficiency in Git/Git hooks via terminal/PowerShell
* UI Frameworks: Hands-on experience with Kendo UI, Angular Material, or SpreadJS libraries
* Communication: Exceptional oral and written communication skills, with a proven ability to interface effectively with international (US) technical teams

* Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.
  
  
India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game-changing solutions and take your career to the next level.
  
  
**Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!**
Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

****Job Description:****
**Role focus:**
Hands-on delivery across Microsoft Power Platform, Power BI, Snowflake, SQL, and AI-enabled business solutions.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The IT Analyst will design, develop, enhance, and support business applications, dashboards, reporting solutions, and workflow automations for the Visualization team. The role requires strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft Power Platform and Power BI, supported by solid Snowflake and SQL capabilities. The successful candidate will work directly with business partners and technical teams to translate requirements into secure, scalable, user-friendly, and data-driven solutions. The role will also contribute to practical AI-enabled capabilities that improve productivity, analytics, and business decision-making.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design, build, test, deploy, and support Power Apps solutions, including Canvas Apps and Model-Driven Apps.
* Develop workflow automation and system integration using Power Automate.
* Build and maintain Power BI reports, dashboards, semantic models, scorecards, and operational analytics.
* Develop efficient DAX measures and Power Query transformations and optimize report performance and usability.
* Use Snowflake and SQL to extract, transform, validate, and analyze data for applications and visualization solutions.
* Partner with business stakeholders to understand requirements, define solution options, and deliver fit-for-purpose outcomes.
* Integrate Power Platform solutions with Dataverse, SharePoint, Teams, APIs, Snowflake, and other approved enterprise data sources.
* Apply security, access control, row-level security, data privacy, governance, and application lifecycle management practices.
* Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement sustainable fixes.
* Create clear technical documentation and provide knowledge transfer and user support.
* Identify opportunities to use AI, Copilot, and automation to improve business processes and analytical experiences.
* Participate in Agile delivery, estimation, testing, release management, and continuous improvement activities.

Required Technical Competencies
  
  
Microsoft Power Platform
  
  

* Strong hands-on experience with Power Apps, particularly Canvas Apps. Experience with Model-Driven Apps is desirable.
* Strong hands-on experience with Power Automate, including approvals, notifications, scheduled flows, and integrations.
* Working knowledge of Dataverse, solution packaging, environment management, connectors, and application lifecycle management.
* Ability to design intuitive user experiences and reusable application components.

Power BI and Visualization
  
  

* Strong hands-on experience developing Power BI reports and dashboards.
* Proficiency in data modeling, DAX, Power Query, semantic models, drill-throughs, bookmarks, and report navigation.
* Experience performance optimization, refreshing troubleshooting, gateway concepts, and row-level security.
* Ability to apply visualization best practices and translate complex data into clear business insights.

Snowflake and SQL
  
  

* Strong SQL skills, including joins, subqueries, common table expressions, aggregations, views, and query optimization.
* Hands-on experience querying and validating data in Snowflake.
* Understanding relational data models, data warehousing, ETL/ELT concepts, data quality, and reconciliation.

AI and Emerging Technology
  
  

* Understanding generative AI concepts and practical enterprise use cases.
* Experience or strong exposure to Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Snowflake Cortex, AI Builder, or AI-enabled Power Platform capabilities.
* Ability to incorporate AI-assisted features into apps, automation, and analytics solutions where appropriate.
* Knowledge of prompt design, responsible AI, data security, privacy, and human validation of AI-generated outputs.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor's or Masters`s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, Analytics, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Approximately 5 -7 years of relevant experience in Power Platform, business intelligence, visualization, analytics, or application development.
* Demonstrated hands-on delivery experience in Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, SQL, and Snowflake.
* Experience gathering requirements and delivering solutions in collaboration with business and technical stakeholders.
* Experience supporting production applications, dashboards, and data solutions in an enterprise environment.

**Preferred Competencies**

* Experience with Copilot Studio, Microsoft Fabric, Azure services, REST APIs, SharePoint Online, or Teams integration.
* Exposure to Tableau or ThoughtSpot.
* Experience with Azure DevOps or comparable work management and CI/CD tool.
* Understanding testing practices, source control, deployment pipelines, monitoring, and support processes.
* Experience working in Agile delivery teams and with global stakeholders.
* Experience in machine manufacturing or a related industrial domain is preferred.

Behavioral Competencies
  
  

* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and attention to detail.
* Customer-focused approach with the ability to understand business needs and recommend practical solutions.
* Clear written and verbal communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently, manage priorities, collaborate across teams, and take ownership of deliverables.
* Curiosity and commitment to continuous learning across Power Platform, analytics, AI, and data technologies.

**Skill Descriptors**

title: Software Development Engineer II, Books Purchase & Payments Experience
description:
**Description**
We are seeking a Software Development Engineer with a passion for innovating on behalf of eBook customers to simplify eBook purchases and Kindle subscriptions. You will build innovative experiences that reduce transaction friction and create extensible solutions for digital purchase experiences that can be leveraged across multiple digital businesses.
  
  
This role offers a unique opportunity to collaborate across services, design and propose new architectures or modify existing ones, and drive the right technical trade-offs between short-term and long-term concerns. You will navigate significant complexity while building features that require changes across various services and pages, including eBooks purchase and store experiences for digital products. The complexity extends further as these features must be scalable and work seamlessly across multiple digital businesses and surfaces, including PC Web Browser, Mobile Web browser, Amazon Android application, Free Kindle reading apps on iOS and Android, and Amazon's E-reader devices.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* As a member of the team, you will spend your time as a hands-on engineer and a technical leader who takes ownership of business/technical problem end to end.
* You will play a key role in defining the architecture for software using a wide range of technologies, programming languages and systems.
* You will be given the freedom to explore your own ideas with the reward of seeing your code raise the bar for millions of Amazon customers worldwide, including your own family and friends.
* You will interface with product manager & stakeholders to understand the business requirements.
* You will author detailed design covering process/data flow diagrams, key trade-offs, technology & cost considerations that you will review with your team’s SDEs/Sr. SDEs as well as impacted upstream/downstream interface SDEs/Sr. SDEs to incorporate feedback resulting in well thought out high quality designs.
* You will engage in design reviews within team as well as within org with aim of providing feedback to elevate the quality of designs.
* You will engage in various team ceremonies like code reviews, daily standup, sprint planning, backlog grooming, sprint retros, operational excellence hand-offs.
* You will actively engage in operational support for your team, and ensure that the root causes of operational issues are identified and resolved.
* You don’t settle for the status quo, and routinely identify and execute on opportunities to improve your team’s operations.
* We embrace the challenges of a fast paced market and evolving technologies and making decisions to provide the best buying experience to our customers.
* You will be encouraged to see the big picture, be innovative, and positively impact millions of customers.
* Successful candidates for this position will have a background in Java or C++. Equally important to these specific skills is a candidate's ability to multi-task, adapt quickly to new development environments and changing business requirements, learn new systems, gain new skills, create reliable & maintainable code, and find creative, scalable solutions to difficult problems.
* The ability to communicate clearly and concisely both written and orally is a key competency as is demonstrable skill as a self-starter.
* We are looking for candidates who are passionate about delivering consistently to our customers, particularly those who want to grow within a world-class engineering team.

**About The Team**
Our team owns the customer purchase experience for a-la-carte eBooks and Kindle Unlimited subscription and related business metrics (e.g., Purchase Success Rate) across all surfaces (Small, Medium, Large and Kindle E-readers) globally. Purchase experience is a holistic view of all Books customer interactions in their journey between intent to buy or subscribe through receipt of their digital product. We enable simplified purchasing CX, new payment methods and products, expand access to new customers and protect customer trust by meeting all regulatory and compliance demands. Our vision is to enable a zero-friction purchase experience, offering all payment methods for Books customers worldwide on any surface
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 3+ years of computer science fundamentals (object-oriented design, data structures, algorithm design, problem solving and complexity analysis) experience
* 2+ years of server-side development experience
* 3+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Internship Program 2026 - Build Your Career Through Real Project Experience
description:
**Job Description**
Launch Your Career with Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited
  
  
**Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited**
is inviting applications from
**2026 graduates**
and a limited number of
**2025 graduates**
for our
**2027 project expansion plans**
.
  
  
We are looking for passionate, self-motivated individuals who aspire to build a successful career by gaining practical industry experience through real-time software development and business projects.
  
  
**Internship Opportunities Are Available In The Following Departments**

* MERN Stack Development
* Software Testing (Manual & Automation)
* Executive Assistant
* Product Design (UI/UX)
* Human Resources (HR)
* DevOps
* IT Support

This internship is designed for candidates who believe that
**knowledge, practical exposure, discipline, and continuous improvement are the foundation of a successful career.**
Unlike conventional training programs, this is a
**real-time industry learning opportunity**
where interns gain hands-on experience by working alongside experienced professionals on live projects.
  
  
Who Should Apply?
  
  
**This Internship Is Ideal For Candidates Who**

* Have graduated in 2026 or are selected from the 2025 graduate batch.
* Are interested in building a career in the ERP and business software domain.
* Are passionate about learning and building a long-term professional career.
* Are willing to learn through practical implementation rather than classroom training.
* Want genuine industry exposure through real-time projects.
* Are self-motivated and committed to continuous learning and improvement.
* Are willing to accept feedback and continuously improve their performance.
* Are prepared to demonstrate their knowledge and skills through practical work and assessments.
* Value knowledge, discipline, professional growth, and long-term career development.

**This program is not intended for candidates whose primary expectation is immediate stipend or salary.**
Our primary objective is to develop skilled professionals who are capable of building successful long-term careers through continuous learning, practical industry experience, discipline, and proven performance.
  
  
Who Should Not Apply?
  
  
Please carefully understand the nature of this opportunity before applying.
  
  
**Candidates Should Not Apply If They**

* Are not interested in the ERP domain or business software industry.
* Expect an immediate stipend or salary from the beginning of the internship.
* Are primarily looking for a paid internship rather than a performance-based learning opportunity.
* Are looking for an internship only to obtain a certificate.
* Are not willing to undergo strong assessments at every stage.
* Are not comfortable with performance-based continuation.
* Are looking only to complete the internship duration without focusing on learning and performance.
* Are not willing to continuously improve their knowledge and practical skills.
* Are not interested in proving their capabilities through actual work and performance.
* Are not interested in a potential long-term employment opportunity with the organization.
* Are unwilling to take ownership, accept feedback, maintain discipline, and demonstrate professional commitment.

Important
  
  
**This opportunity is not designed for candidates who are looking only for a certificate, immediate payment, or a short-term internship experience.**
**Certification is not guaranteed merely for joining or attending the program.**
This opportunity is for candidates who are genuinely willing to:
  
  
**Learn → Practice → Perform → Improve → Prove Themselves → Build a Career**
If you are genuinely interested in the ERP domain, willing to invest your time and effort in learning, and want to prove yourself through performance with the possibility of securing a
**Fresher employment opportunity**
, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
Nature of the Internship
  
  
This internship follows a
**Self-Learning with Industry Mentorship Model.**
**Candidates Will Be Expected To**

* Learn independently with guidance from mentors.
* Complete assigned learning modules and project tasks.
* Work on real client and internal projects.
* Take ownership of assigned responsibilities.
* Continuously improve technical and professional skills.
* Demonstrate discipline, professionalism, and accountability throughout the program.
* Accept feedback positively and implement improvements.
* Demonstrate consistent performance throughout the internship.

Success in this internship depends largely on the candidate's willingness to learn, adapt, take responsibility, and consistently perform.
  
  
Selection Process
  
  
Stage 1 – Five-Day Assessment Program
  
  
Before being admitted into the internship program, every applicant must successfully complete a
**5-working-day assessment**
.
  
  
During this assessment, candidates will be assigned practical tasks to evaluate not only technical aptitude but also professional qualities.
  
  
**The Evaluation Includes**

* Learning ability
* Problem-solving approach
* Discipline and punctuality
* Sincerity and commitment
* Professional ethics
* Ownership and accountability
* Communication skills
* Adaptability
* Consistency in task completion
* Overall suitability for the internship program

Only candidates who successfully complete this assessment will be offered internship positions.
  
  
Internship Structure and Stipend Eligibility
  
  
The internship will be for
**150 working days**
, divided into
**six blocks of 25 working days each**
.
  
  
Block Duration Stipend Blocks 1–3 75 working days
**No stipend**
Block 4 25 working days ₹5,000\* Block 5 25 working days ₹5,000\* Block 6 25 working days ₹5,000\*
**Total**
**150 working days**
**Up to ₹15,000**
\*
  
  
Stipend eligibility is directly connected to the candidate's performance and successful progression through the internship blocks.
  
  
**Candidates Who Successfully Progress To**
**Block 4 → ₹5,000 stipend**
**Block 5 → ₹5,000 stipend**
**Block 6 → ₹5,000 stipend**
will be eligible for the applicable stipend only after satisfying the required performance standards for the respective block.
  
  
The organization reserves the right to determine stipend eligibility based on the candidate's performance assessment.
  
  
Block-Wise Performance Assessment
  
  
At the end of
**every 25-working-day block**
, candidates will undergo a
**strict performance assessment**
.
  
  
**Each Assessment Will Evaluate**

* Technical learning progress
* Practical implementation skills
* Quality of work
* Discipline and attendance
* Professional behaviour
* Ownership of responsibilities
* Ability to improve based on feedback
* Team collaboration
* Communication
* Problem-solving ability
* Commitment towards career development
* Overall performance

**Candidates who successfully clear the assessment will be allowed to continue to the next block.**
Candidates who do not meet the required standards may be discontinued from the internship and will not be allowed to progress to the next block.
  
  
Performance-Based Continuation
  
  
Continuation in the internship is
**entirely based on performance**
.
  
  
**Candidates Who Consistently Demonstrate**

* Learning capability
* Professional conduct
* Improvement mindset
* Discipline
* Accountability
* Positive attitude
* Technical and practical improvement
* Consistency
* Commitment to excellence

will continue through the internship program.
  
  
Candidates who fail to meet the expected standards at any stage may be discontinued from the internship without progressing to the next block.
  
  
**Completion of a particular number of days does not automatically qualify a candidate for the next block. Successful assessment is mandatory for progression.**
Employment Opportunity
  
  
Candidates who successfully complete
**all six internship blocks (150 working days)**
with
**strong, consistent, and proven performance**
will be considered for a
**Fresher employment opportunity**
with the organization.
  
  
**Candidates Who Demonstrate**

* Strong learning capability
* Consistent performance
* Better assessment ratings
* Technical and practical competency
* Professional discipline
* Ownership and accountability
* Positive attitude
* Adaptability
* Ability to contribute effectively to the organization

may offered a
**Fresher role with a starting CTC of ₹1.8 LPA**
, subject to the organization's final assessment, available positions, and business requirements.
  
  
The employment opportunity is intended for candidates who successfully demonstrate strong performance and achieve the required assessment standards throughout the complete internship program.
  
  
Terms & Conditions
  
  
By applying for this internship, candidates acknowledge and agree to the following:
  
  

* Successful completion of the 5-working-day assessment is mandatory before joining the internship.
* The internship consists of six assessment blocks of 25 working days each, totaling 150 working days.

title: Apprentice - Enterprise Technology Services
description:
**Job Description**
Innovation is at the heart of everything we do. Every single day, our technologists enable our customers around the globe to achieve their goals. They design and deliver American Express infrastructure and applications across all markets and business units. To meet these demands, we’re looking for problem solvers who can get results through precise analysis and programming methodologies, individuals with a strong intellectual curiosity and a passion for innovation, and teammates who can convert their ideas into execution.
  
  
Join our 12-month paid apprenticeship program where you will have opportunities for development, networking and engaging with our executives. An apprenticeship at American Express will give you the chance to influence and strengthen the core businesses across the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Join the team and make an impact right away:
  
  

* Write code with one or more programming languages (e.g., Java, JavaScript, .NET, Python)
* Function as a core member of an agile team working on API specs, conducting code reviews and testing in ongoing sprints, or doing proof of concepts/automation tools
* Design and develop new customer-facing applications on multiple channels like native iOS, Android, web, social integration and Java services/APIs
* Design and implement web-enabled systems for data collection

We have the know-how, technology, and global reach to make nearly any idea a reality. All that’s missing is you! Do you have?
  
  

* Passion for technology and strong desire to learn
* Curious mind to explore new possibilities and act on them
* Never-settle attitude and continuously looking for improvements
* Customer-focus to think differently and deliver value to customers
* Data-driven nature to drive decisions and results based on data

**Qualifications**

* The candidate must have completed graduation under Bachelor’s or Master’s degree program in Computer Science and Information Technology Engineering or other technical discipline

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.
  
  
Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.
  
  

* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
* Career development and training opportunities

**About Us**
At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
  
  
As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

title: Digital Architect
description:
CXOntology is looking for a
**Digital Architect**
who can lead solution design and delivery across digital experience programs. The role needs someone who understands CMS platforms, commerce platforms, marketing technology, analytics, and consulting-led delivery.

This person will work with clients, internal delivery teams, stakeholders, and executive teams to define the right solution, guide implementation, own technical direction, and ensure the team delivers business outcomes, not just tasks.

**Minimum Expectations:**

* Experience working on 2+ CMS platforms, such as Drupal/Acquia, Contentful, Contentstack, AEM, Optimizely, Sitecore, or similar.
* Experience with at least one commerce platform, such as Shopify, Adobe Commerce/Magento, BigCommerce, commercetools, or similar.
* Understanding of marketing technology stacks, including CRM, marketing automation, CDP/personalization, campaign operations, and customer journey activation.
* Working knowledge of analytics and measurement, including GA4, GTM, attribution, conversion tracking, dashboards, and KPI reporting.
* Ability to lead strategy and consulting conversations with clients, including discovery, current-state assessment, roadmap definition, and recommendation framing.
* Strong solution design capability across CMS, commerce, integrations, front-end, cloud, analytics, and marketing technology.
* Ability to take delivery ownership for technical decisions, risks, dependencies, estimates, implementation quality, and release readiness.
* Experience collaborating with client stakeholders and executive teams, translating technical choices into business impact.

**Core Responsibilities:**

* Lead architecture and solution design for digital experience, commerce, marketing technology, and analytics-led programs.
* Own technical discovery and translate business goals into clear platform and implementation recommendations.
* Define solution blueprints, integration approaches, technical roadmaps, and delivery plans.
* Guide the delivery team across engineers, QA, DevOps, UX, analytics, and marketing operations teams.
* Review technical designs, unblock delivery teams, and ensure implementation quality.
* Identify platform risks, technical debt, dependencies, and ownership gaps early.
* Support managed services, migrations, CRO, platform optimization, and AI-enabled digital workflows.
* Communicate clearly with client stakeholders, senior leadership, and executive sponsors.

**Required Experience:**

* 7+ years in digital platforms, CMS, commerce, MarTech, web engineering, solution consulting.
* 4+ years in an architect, lead engineer, technical consultant, solution design role.
* Hands-on background in CMS, commerce, integrations, front-end, cloud delivery.
* Strong understanding of performance, accessibility, SEO, security, analytics, QA, and release governance.
* Ability to work across business, technology, marketing, and delivery teams.

**Success In This Role:**

Success means the delivery teams has clear technical direction, the client understands the recommended path, risks are visible early, and delivered solutions improve platform health, customer experience, conversion, and business outcomes.

title: Senior Engineer- React
