As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.
  
  
**About Energy Systems**
We help customers navigate the complex transition to a decarbonized and more sustainable energy future. We do this by assuring that energy systems work safely and effectively, using solutions that are increasingly digital. We also help industries and governments to navigate the many complex, interrelated transitions taking place globally and regionally, in the energy industry.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Senior Software Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, and supporting production-grade software products and shared platform capabilities within DNV’s Digital & Transformation organization. This role sits within the Application Engineering section and contributes to the development and modernization of scalable web applications that support digital delivery across Energy Systems.
  
  
This role helps to advance how DNV performs Due Diligence, Verification & Assurance, and Renewables Certification work across Energy Systems.
  
  
This is not a project-based delivery or staff-augmentation role. Engineers are expected to develop deep product knowledge and remain accountable for the quality, maintainability, and operation of the software they build.
  
  
Working in close partnership with our UX Designer, Backend Engineers, Product leadership, Data & AI Engineering, Solution Engineering, Platform Reliability, Solution Architecture, and Platform Security & Compliance, this role helps bring application capabilities, data services, AI-enabled features, workflows, and APIs into one cohesive platform and product experience.
  
  
The Senior Software Engineer designs, builds, tests, deploys, and supports scalable software across a modern Microsoft-oriented full-stack environment. The primary stack includes React, TypeScript, Redux, Tailwind CSS, and a modern .NET backend on Azure, with project management in Azure DevOps. The role requires strong engineering fundamentals, practical cloud experience, and the ability to collaborate effectively across globally distributed teams.
  
  
This role supports custom software development, application modernization, and integration with low-code or hybrid development environments, helping establish shared patterns, APIs, reusable components, and maintainable application architecture across the platform.
  
  
This role is based at our DNV office in Chennai, India. Further details regarding role-specific requirements will be shared during the interview process.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Software Engineering & Delivery**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable application and platform capabilities using modern software engineering practices.
* Build cohesive product experiences across web applications, user interfaces, and platform integrations.
* Work directly with Product and Architecture stakeholders to shape requirements, evaluate technical approaches, and translate product direction into maintainable, production-ready software.
* Participate actively in code reviews, technical design discussions, estimation, delivery planning, and implementation decisions.
* Write clean, well-structured, testable, and maintainable code that supports long-term product quality and team velocity.
* Own product capabilities through design, implementation, deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and iterative improvement rather than treating delivery as complete when the initial feature is released.

**React Application Development**

* Build responsive, reusable, and accessible frontend experiences using TypeScript, React, Redux, and Tailwind CSS, integrated with secure and maintainable .NET backend services.
* Use the established design system and contribute to its continual improvement.
* Support application modernization efforts, including refactoring, technical debt reduction, framework upgrades, and migration from legacy patterns where appropriate.
* Develop application capabilities used for structured review workflows, real-time collaboration, issue tracking, customer interaction, reporting, and delivery of technical work products.
* Partner with Product and design stakeholders to ensure application functionality is intuitive, reliable, and aligned with user workflows.
* Contribute to reusable development patterns, documentation, and engineering practices that improve team velocity and consistency.
* Build reusable components that make data, AI outputs, workflow status, and platform capabilities accessible within the user experience.
* Integrate data-driven, search, agentic, and AI-enabled capabilities into production web applications using well-defined APIs and reusable application patterns.

**Modern Development & AI-Enabled Engineering**

* Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, testing, debugging, documentation, refactoring, and engineering analysis.
* Apply strong engineering judgment when using LLM-enabled workflows, ensuring generated or assisted code meets standards for quality, security, maintainability, and performance.
* Use AI-enabled tools where appropriate to support test generation, code review preparation, technical documentation, and developer productivity.

**DevOps, Reliability & Security**

* Contribute to Azure DevOps repositories and pipelines, automated testing, deployment automation, environment management, monitoring, and incident readiness.
* Build software using an Agile methodology, with strong attention to reliability, performance, availability, scalability, and operational support.
* Support observability practices including logging, monitoring, error handling, and production diagnostics.
* Follow secure development practices aligned with internal security standards, SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and enterprise security expectations.
* Collaborate with Platform Reliability, Security, and Global Shared Services teams to support secure, reliable, and maintainable production systems.

**Collaboration & Technical Ownership**

* Work effectively with Product, Solution Engineering, Data & AI Engineering, Platform Reliability, Architecture, Security, and regional teams in a globally distributed environment.
* Take ownership of assigned features, services, defects, and technical improvements from design through production support.
* Communicate technical trade-offs clearly and contribute to pragmatic engineering decisions.
* Mentor less experienced engineers through code reviews, technical guidance, pairing, and shared engineering practices.
* Contribute to a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and delivery excellence.
* Contribute actively within planning and design meetings, speaking up where potential issues arise or where a requirement is poorly defined.
* Champion potential solutions to problems and communicate them clearly to the team

What we offer
  
  

* Flexible work arrangements for better work-life balance
* Generous Paid Leaves (Annual, Sick, Compassionate, Local Public, Marriage, Maternity, Paternity, Medical leave)
* Medical benefits ( Insurance and Annual Health Check-up)
* Pension and Insurance Policies (Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance, Travel Insurance)
* Training and Development Assistance (Training Sponsorship, On-The-Job Training, Training Programme)
* Additional Benefits (Long Service Awards, Mobile Phone Reimbursement)
* Company bonus/Profit share.

\*Benefits may vary based on position, tenure/contract/grade level\*
  
  
DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.
  
  
**About You**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of experience developing production software in application engineering, software engineering, platform engineering, or related technical roles.
* Strong experience developing production web applications using modern full-stack technologies.
* Strong production experience developing frontend applications using React and TypeScript, particularly for real-time collaborative applications.
* Experience consuming REST APIs and contributing to the design of new REST APIs.
* Experience building, modernizing, or operating scalable web applications in production environments, especially applications that support complex workflows, collaboration, reporting, document review, or customer-facing delivery.
* Experience developing, deploying, and supporting cloud-hosted applications, with practical experience in Microsoft Azure strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of software design, testing, code quality, maintainability, security, and performance.
* Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, source control, code review, and modern software delivery practices.
* Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted development tools or LLM-enabled coding workflows to improve development productivity.
* Ability to collaborate with Product, Architecture, Security, Platform Reliability, and cross-functional stakeholders in a matrixed environment.
* Strong English communication skills and ability to work effectively across globally distributed teams.

**What Is Preferred**

* Experience in working with C# code.
* Experience with AI integration technologies such as AG-UI.
* Experience with collaborative due diligence, document review, workflow, reporting, Q&A, risk management, or transaction delivery applications.
* Experience of working with a real-time collaborative system.
* Experience in product-led or platform-based organizations.
* Familiarity with low-code or hybrid development environments.
* Experience supporting interoperability across multiple systems or enterprise platforms.
* Experience with multi-cloud environments spanning Azure and AWS.
* Background in energy, infrastructure, renewables, assurance, certification, or other technically complex industries.
* Experience with multi-cloud environments spanning Azure and AWS.
* Experience modernizing legacy applications or integrating acquired software products into a broader enterprise platform.

title: Sitecore AI Front-end Developer
description:
**Job Family**
Software Application & Development (India)
  
  
**Travel Required**
None
  
  
**Clearance Required**
None
  
  
**What You Will Do**
We are seeking a Front-end Developer focused on Sitecore AI development to build polished, accessible, and high-performing digital experiences on our enterprise Sitecore platform. In this role, you will develop reusable front-end components and Sitecore AI solutions; translate product, content, and design requirements into maintainable implementations; create intuitive visual authoring experiences; and deliver AI-enabled capabilities that improve content discovery, personalization, and customer engagement. You will collaborate with the Sitecore Architect, UX designers, content teams, marketing stakeholders, back-end and integration engineers, and external partners using Sitecore XM Cloud, React, Next.js, TypeScript, the Sitecore Content SDK, GraphQL, Experience Edge, Vercel, and modern cloud delivery practices.
  
  

* Develop reusable, responsive, and accessible React and Next.js components for Sitecore AI, translating approved designs into clean, maintainable TypeScript.
* Create flexible component data models, rendering definitions, placeholders, variants, and visual authoring configurations that enable content teams to build pages efficiently and safely.
* Integrate frontend applications with Sitecore Experience Edge, GraphQL, the Sitecore Content SDK, and approved APIs and services.
* Develop and integrate Sitecore AI capabilities—including AI-assisted search, recommendations, content discovery, and personalization—in partnership with architecture, analytics, content, and integration teams, with appropriate privacy, security, and governance controls.
* Collaborate with UX and design teams to ensure accurate implementation of design systems, interaction patterns, responsive behavior, and cross-browser compatibility.
* Optimize Core Web Vitals, rendering performance, caching, image delivery, SEO/GEO, accessibility, and client-side application behavior.
* Write unit, integration, accessibility, and end-to-end tests; participate in code reviews; and support automated quality checks within CI/CD pipelines.
* Troubleshoot complex frontend, rendering, personalization, API, deployment, and content-delivery issues using browser tools, logs, monitoring, and root-cause analysis.
* Implement privacy-conscious analytics and engagement tracking, including approved GA4 event contracts, consent-aware behavior, and data-layer standards.
* Improve frontend standards, shared libraries, documentation, development tooling, and delivery practices while mentoring peers through reviews and knowledge sharing.

**What You Will Need**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* At least 4 years of front-end or full-stack development experience, including hands-on delivery of Sitecore-based digital experiences and AI-enabled capabilities in enterprise environments.
* Strong proficiency in React, Next.js, TypeScript or JavaScript, semantic HTML, modern CSS, responsive design, and component-based development.
* Hands-on experience developing headless Sitecore XM Cloud and Sitecore AI solutions using Sitecore JSS or the Sitecore Content SDK, Experience Edge, GraphQL, and Vercel.
* Experience creating Sitecore components, content models, rendering parameters, placeholders, variants, and author-friendly visual editing experiences.
* Experience consuming REST and GraphQL APIs and integrating frontend applications with enterprise services such as analytics, identity, consent management, search, CRM, or personalization platforms.
* Working knowledge of Sitecore headless patterns, composable DXP architecture, design systems, and reusable frontend architecture.
* Experience with Git-based development, pull requests, automated testing, code-quality tools, and CI/CD deployment practices.
* Demonstrated ability to improve web performance, Core Web Vitals, accessibility, SEO, browser compatibility, security, and frontend resilience.
* Ability to diagnose rendering, state-management, caching, API, build, deployment, and content-delivery issues across environments.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, collaborate across disciplines, and support peers through code reviews, troubleshooting, documentation, and knowledge sharing.

**What Would Be Nice To Have**

* Experience with Sitecore products such as Search, CDP, Personalize, Content Hub, or SXA.
* Experience implementing AI-assisted search, recommendations, conversational interfaces, content discovery, or personalization within customer-facing digital experiences.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure or another major cloud platform and with serverless or edge-based application patterns.
* Familiarity with Storybook, automated accessibility testing, visual regression testing, performance testing, and modern frontend observability tools.
* Knowledge of SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), and generative engine optimization (GEO) principles for structured, discoverable web content.
* Sitecore certification or equivalent demonstrated expertise.
* Experience working in regulated, high-traffic, or complex enterprise environments.
* Strong presentation and stakeholder-management skills.

description:
**About Us**
Foodhub currently has 30,000+ restaurant, takeaway, stadia, hotel and bar clients in the UK, Ireland, USA, Canada, Nigeria, Grenada and ANZ. Today, Foodhub powers the technology behind many different QSR's, stadia and venue, online order, delivery and POS businesses, giving them a multi-solution tech stack to drive their business forward and open new revenue streams.
  
  
From the moment a consumer is thinking of placing an order, to the time the order arrives at their door and a review is posted to social media, Foodhub has solutions to drive the consumer experience, whilst adding extra value via our ecosystem of partners. The Foodhub Tech Stack is extensive: from Web and Mobile Ordering to 3rd Party Order Aggregation, Dispatch and Self-Delivery, complete Hardware/Software POS systems, extensive array of POS integrations, On-Premise Kiosks, QR Code Ordering and Payment, Table-side Mobile Order/Receipt Printers, plus an extensive product and development team to support all of this.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a skilled Mobile Application Developer to design, develop, test, and deploy high-quality cross-platform mobile applications using React Native and TypeScript for iOS and Android. This role involves leveraging modern AI coding assistants to accelerate delivery without compromising quality.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test and deploy high-quality cross-platform mobile applications using React Native and TypeScript for iOS and Android.
* Take ownership of feature delivery end-to-end, from technical design through release, monitoring and post-launch iteration.
* Translate product requirements into clear technical specifications and design documents.
* Contribute to and influence the mobile architecture, including state management, navigation, offline behavior, modularization and native bridges.
* Work with the React Native New Architecture (Fabric, TurboModules, JSI) and Hermes to deliver performant, memory-efficient applications.
* Build and maintain reusable component libraries and shared modules used across multiple Foodhub brands and applications.
* Develop and integrate native modules in Swift and Kotlin where required, and debug native build issues across Xcode and Android Studio.
* Optimize application performance, including bundle size, startup time, frame rates, list virtualization, memory usage and crash rates.
* Implement and maintain robust automated testing using Jest, React Native Testing Library and end-to-end frameworks such as Detox or Maestro.
* Own and improve mobile CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Fast lane, EAS Build, App Center or equivalent.
* Lead code reviews with a strong focus on quality, security, accessibility and maintainability.
* Establish and maintain project-level AI context configurations and coding standards documentation.
* Mentor mid-level and junior engineers on React Native, TypeScript, mobile best practices and the responsible use of AI development tools.
* Collaborate closely with Product, Design, Backend, QA and EPOS/POS teams to translate business requirements into well-scoped technical solutions.
* Contribute to engineering standards, documentation, technical specifications and the continuous improvement of team processes.

**Preferred Skills**

* Familiarity with emerging standards such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and the integration of AI tooling into developer workflows is desirable.

**Requirements**
Qualifications
  
  

* Minimum 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.
* At least 5 years of hands-on production experience building React Native applications in TypeScript.
* Demonstrable experience shipping and maintaining mobile applications that are live on the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.

**Required Skills**

* Strong, advanced-level TypeScript skills, including strict mode, generics, discriminated unions, utility types and disciplined API typing.
* Practical experience with the React Native New Architecture (Fabric, TurboModules, JSI) and the Hermes JavaScript engine.
* Deep understanding of React Native internals, including the bridge, lifecycle, rendering pipeline, reconciliation and threading model.
* Experience writing or extending native modules in Swift (iOS) and Kotlin (Android).
* Proficiency with modern state management approaches such as Redux Toolkit, Zustand, Jotai, MobX or React Query.
* Strong working knowledge of React Navigation, including deep linking, universal links, App Links and complex navigation patterns.
* Experience with offline-first architectures, secure local storage, push notifications, background tasks and OTA updates.
* Hands-on experience with mobile CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Fast lane, EAS Build, Bitrise or App Center.
* Strong testing discipline using Jest, React Native Testing Library and at least one end-to-end framework.
* Solid understanding of REST and/or GraphQL API integration, authentication flows and secure communication on mobile.
* Working knowledge of mobile application security best practices.
* Proficiency with Git and modern branching workflows.
* Daily, hands-on use of AI coding assistants as a core part of the development workflow.
* Demonstrated judgment in applying AI assistance appropriately.

**YOUR TEAM.**
 This position offers the opportunity to collaborate with innovative marketers to execute on brand awareness and lead generation campaigns across industry verticals and buyer roles. You will work cross\-functionally with our U.S. based marketing team and business units, and external developers to execute campaigns and the digital roadmap.

 At CohnReznick, we’re united by a common mission to create opportunity, value, and trust for our clients, our people, and our communities. Whether it’s working alongside your peers to solve a client challenge, or volunteering together at the local food bank, there are so many ways to find your “why” at the firm.
   

  

 We believe it’s important to balance work with everyday life – and make time for enjoyment and fun. We invest in a robust Total Rewards package that includes everything from generous PTO, a flexible work environment, expanded parental leave, extensive learning \& development, and even paid time off for employees to volunteer.
   

  

**YOUR ROLE.**
 This full time, direct hire position offers the opportunity to collaborate with innovative marketers to execute on brand awareness and lead generation campaigns across industry verticals and buyer roles. In this role, you will be responsible for executing a comprehensive website strategy, optimizing for both on\-page and off\-page SEO/AEO/GEO, and managing day\-to\-day website operations and enhancements. This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in shaping CohnReznick’s online presence and driving our digital marketing initiatives. You will work cross\-functionally with our U.S. based marketing team and business units, and external developers to execute campaigns and the digital roadmap. The ideal candidate for this role is passionate about website management, detail oriented, and thrives when given the opportunity to be hands\-on and test new ideas.
   

  

 This role will work directly with the digital marketing team and manager based in Chennai. You will collaborate with key internal stakeholders to maintain and execute projects to enhance our digital presence through showcasing our corporate, thought leadership, and recruiting content.
   

  

 You will report to the Digital Manager and collaborate with other members of the marketing team to manage content development, update the site and organize ongoing enhancements to the user experience. Current efforts include performing daily content updates to CohnReznick’s site, updating landing pages on the site, creating new pages, analyzing metrics, staying current with industry best practices, and being comfortable juggling multiple projects simultaneously.
   

  

**Responsibilities Include But Not Limited To**
* Build and update web pages within our CMS for cohnreznick.com
* Support SEO/AEO/GEO Optimization: Execute on\-page and off\-page strategies to improve organic search rankings and increase website traffic.
* Design and build conversion rate optimized web pages to maximize lead generation and customer acquisition.
* Support accessibility best practices implementing meta tags and content updates on the site
* Analytics and Insights: Track, generate, and review web for marketing campaigns using Google Analytics, Tag manager and Search Console
* Collaborate with U.S. based content and creative team to execute and optimize campaigns.
* Assist with video production and publishing on the site
* Project manage and communicate status updates with internal team and agency vendors using tools like WorkFront, JIRA, and Slack.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree
* Proven experience (4 \+ years) working on a corporate website and SEO
* Knowledge of HTML \& CSS, UI/UX, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager and Moz
* Ability to troubleshoot and solve technical issues quickly
* Experience with Optimizely or similar CXP platform to manage website content and SEO.
* Excellent written, oral, and interpersonal communication skills
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment and manage multiple projects
* Highly analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail
* Strong organizational skills and superior attention to detail
* Tech savvy with interest in learning new programs and proficiency in Microsoft Office programs, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint


 In addition, please take a moment to review our
 **Universal Job Standards.**
 Studies have shown that we are less likely to apply to jobs unless we meet every single qualification. At CohnReznick, we are dedicated to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or one of our other roles.
   

  

 "CohnReznick" is the brand name under which CohnReznick LLP and CohnReznick Advisory LLC and their respective subsidiaries provide professional services. CohnReznick LLP and CohnReznick Advisory LLC (and their respective subsidiaries) practice in an alternative practice structure in accordance with the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct and applicable law, regulations, and professional standards. description:

 We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer to lead the development of our cloud\-based Network Management System (NMS) platform. This role involves building sophisticated web applications and mobile interfaces that enable enterprise customers to monitor, configure, and manage their network infrastructure including switches, routers, and WiFi access points at scale.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* NMS Platform Development: Design and develop scalable web applications for network device management, monitoring, and configuration
* Real\-time Dashboard Creation: Build responsive dashboards displaying network topology, device status, performance metrics, and alerting systems
* Device Integration: Develop APIs and interfaces for managing diverse network hardware (switches, routers, access points) from multiple vendors
* Network Visualization: Create interactive network topology maps and device relationship diagrams
* Mobile Management Apps: Build mobile applications for field technicians to configure and troubleshoot network devices remotely
* Performance Monitoring: Implement real\-time network performance monitoring, SNMP integration, and telemetry data visualization
* Configuration Management: Develop tools for bulk device configuration, firmware updates, and policy deployment
* Alert Systems: Build intelligent alerting and notification systems for network events and anomalies
* Multi\-tenant Architecture: Contribute to secure, scalable multi\-tenant SaaS platform architecture
* API Development: Create RESTful APIs for third\-party integrations and customer automation workflows


**Technical Requirements**

* Backend: Strong experience with Node.js, Python, or Java for building scalable network management services
* Network Protocols: Understanding of SNMP, SSH, Telnet, NETCONF, REST APIs for network device communication
* Database Systems: Experience with time\-series databases (InfluxDB, TimescaleDB) for network metrics and traditional databases
* Cloud Platforms: AWS/Azure/GCP experience with focus on networking services, load balancers, and auto\-scaling
* Monitoring Tools: Experience with network monitoring protocols, log aggregation, and observability platforms
* Security: Knowledge of network security principles, VPN configurations, and secure device access methods
* DevOps: CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and infrastructure automation


**Domain\-Specific Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Network Engineering, or related technical field
* 8\-10 years of full\-stack development experience with 3\+ years in network management or infrastructure software
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP, OSI model, routing protocols, and enterprise networking concepts
* Experience with network device APIs (Cisco, Juniper, Aruba, Ubiquiti, etc.)
* Knowledge of WiFi standards (802\.11\), network switching concepts, and routing protocols
* Experience building SaaS platforms for enterprise customers
* Familiarity with network automation tools (Ansible, Puppet) and Infrastructure as Code

**We are the ASSA ABLOY Group**

description:
**About Firstsource**
 Firstsource Solutions Limited, an RP\-Sanjiv Goenka Group company (NSE: FSL, BSE: 532809, Reuters: FISO.BO, Bloomberg: FSOL:IN), is a specialized global business process services partner, providing transformational solutions and services spanning the customer lifecycle across Healthcare, Banking and Financial Services, Communications, Media and Technology, Retail, and other diverse industries. **Job Brief**
 We are seeking a highly experienced and hands\-on Lead AI Engineer to drive the design, development, and delivery of enterprise\-scale AI products. This role combines technical leadership with deep engineering expertise, requiring active involvement in product feature architecture, full\-stack application development, AI/ML model integration, code reviews, release management, and engineering best practices within our AI Product Engineering team.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Python, Machine Learning, Cloud Technologies, and modern full\-stack development, with a proven ability to lead technical teams while remaining actively engaged in coding. They should be passionate about building scalable, production\-ready AI products, mentoring engineers, establishing technical standards, and collaborating with Product Managers and cross\-functional teams to transform product requirements into robust, high\-performance AI\-powered product features.
   

  

**Mandatory Technical Skills**
* 4 to 6\+ years of hands\-on software development experience with strong coding expertise.

* Strong expertise in Full Stack Development: Backend (Python, FastAPI, Flask, Django) and Frontend (React.js, Angular, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3\).
* Experience developing and maintaining REST APIs and Microservices.
* Strong understanding of Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP), SOLID Principles, Design Patterns, and Domain\-Driven Design (DDD).
* Hands\-on experience building, training, fine\-tuning, and deploying Machine Learning models.
* Experience with ML frameworks such as Scikit\-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, and XGBoost.
* Experience deploying AI/ML solutions into production environments and implementing MLOps practices.
* Strong hands\-on experience with AWS and/or Azure Cloud Platforms (Mandatory).
* Experience with cloud\-native development, containerization, and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, DevOps, and Infrastructure as Code.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, event\-driven architecture, scalability, performance optimization, and security best practices.
* Experience working with relational and NoSQL databases.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.


**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable full\-stack applications using Python and modern front\-end frameworks.
* Build and deploy Machine Learning and AI\-powered solutions for enterprise use cases.
* Actively contribute to coding, code reviews, debugging, and performance optimization activities.
* Develop and maintain REST APIs, microservices, and cloud\-native applications.
* Design scalable, secure, and maintainable software architectures following industry best practices.
* Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines, DevOps, and MLOps processes.
* Deploy, monitor, and optimize applications and ML models on AWS and/or Azure.

* Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across application, infrastructure, and data layers.

* Mentor and guide team members on technical design, coding standards, and engineering best practices.

* 4\-6\+ years of overall experience.

title: Microsoft-F And O Technical-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**AI Business Solutions – Dynamics F\&SCM Commerce Technical Senior :**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 As a Microsoft Dynamics 365 Commerce Technical Senior at EY GDS, you will contribute to the success of enterprise\-scale D365 F\&O implementations, primarily in the Retail and commerce domain. You will have the opportunity to work with a growing team and play a key role in delivering financial transformation solutions, process improvements, and ERP implementations to global clients, helping build a better working world.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Build and maintain strong client relationships through value\-driven consulting, technical leadership, and proactive engagement.
* Lead the technical design and development of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Commerce solutions, with a focus on POS systems (MPOS/CPOS) \& B2C /B2B Website.
* Configure and extend Store Commerce, Hardware Station, and integrate peripherals such as printers, scanners, cash drawers, and payment devices.
* Configure and extend B2C \& B2B website, Site builder.
* Develop custom POS functionalities using Commerce SDK, Online SDK , TypeScript, JavaScript, C\#, and .NET Core.
* Implement integrations between POS and backend systems: ERP (F\&O), payment gateways, fiscal printers, loyalty programs, and eCommerce platforms.
* Design and maintain offline\-first POS architecture, ensuring performance, fault tolerance, and scalability across store networks.
* Collaborate with functional consultants to translate business needs into detailed technical designs and functional design documents (FDDs).
* Utilize Azure DevOps and Lifecycle Services (LCS) for source control, CI/CD pipelines, and environment management.
* Support system testing, performance tuning, deployment, and go\-live activities.
* Conduct code reviews, enforce best development practices, and maintain thorough technical documentation.
* Provide Level 3 support post\-go\-live to resolve POS\-related issues and ensure smooth store operations.
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Familiarity with Power Platform, especially Power Apps and Power BI, is a plus.
* Ability to conceptualize and design future\-state business processes.
* Experience in conducting GAP analysis, solution testing, and user training.
* Good understanding of security roles, data management, Azure DevOps, and LCS environments.


**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Knowledge of integration with other Microsoft technologies such as Azure, Power Platform.
* Familiarity with industry\-specific retail practices and compliance requirements.
* Experience working in multi\-country and multi\-legal entity environments.
* Strong documentation, stakeholder communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Proven ability to lead discovery workshops, manage offshore teams, and mentor junior consultants.
* A proactive mindset with the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a global, fast\-paced environment.


**What We Look For**
* 5–10 years of experience in D365 Commerce technical.
* Minimum 3 full\-cycle D365 F\&O implementations in Commerce domains.
* Strong domain knowledge of Retail \& eCommerce
* Strong domain knowledge of D365 Site builder tool
* Strong analytical and debugging skills with a focus on performance and reliability.
* Experience with Microsoft SureStep, Agile, or hybrid implementation methodologies.
* Proficiency in working with globally distributed teams and stakeholders.
* Microsoft certifications such as MB\-340, MB\-900 are preferred.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.


 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
Design, build, and support SAP ABAP and Fiori enhancements, reports, interfaces, forms, and applications aligned to business requirements. Role Overview A technical role delivered under a strict clean-core mandate. The program has deliberately constrained its build: 79% of requirements are met by standard configuration, and the WRICEF objects will be gated behind conditions precedent - a validated requirement, a quantified benefit, and confirmation that no standard alternative exists - and extensions are delivered on SAP BTP rather than by modifying the core. This role needs judgment as well as skill: the largest technical risk on the program is over-customization, specifically rebuilding a legacy shop-floor system''s bespoke lot-numbering and lot-handling logic one-for-one inside SAP. You will be expected to resist that. Key Responsibilities Translate functional specifications from all workstreams into technical designs, honest estimates and clean-core-compliant build approaches; challenge designs better solved by configuration.Develop the report backlog using CDS views, RAP services and analytical Fiori applications in preference to classical ABAP list reports.Develop enhancements using released extension points - BAdIs, key-user and developer extensibility - rather than core modifications or implicit enhancements.Design and build interfaces between S/4HANA, SAP Digital Manufacturing, factory-automation and edge systems and the analytics layer, using SAP BTP Integration Suite (Cloud Integration, API Management, Event Mesh) plus IDoc, OData, REST and file patterns.Build custom and extended Fiori applications with SAPUI5 / Fiori Elements, including shop-floor UIs usable on hand-held devices and gloved hands, with Japanese and English language support.Build the traveler / batch-card print program and forms carrying resolved machine, tool, hardness, mold, cavity and lot detail; implement quality, hold and disposition approval workflows; build the flexible master-data maintenance application if it clears its gate.Build the composite KPI CDS layer and the post-Material-Ledger allocation engine in the agreed architecture; enforce clean-core governance - extension registry, released-API discipline, upgrade-safety review, code review - and document objects so client IT can maintain them. BATCH MANAGEMENT TRACEABILITY EXPERIENCE - REQUIRED Hands-on Batch Management and end-to-end traceability experience is a mandatory requirement for this role. Batch, lot and cavity-level traceability sits at the center of this program; candidates without demonstrable hands-on experience in the following will not be shortlisted:Batch and classification data structures in S/4HANA - batch master, characteristics and classification, batch determination and status - and how to read, extend and report on them without breaking standard behavior.Batch number assignment: standard internal/external number ranges, the batch number BAdI, and the judgment to say honestly when a bespoke lot-number format genuinely cannot be met by standard next-number maintenance. Replicating legacy lot-numbering one-for-one is this program''s largest over-customization risk.Batch characteristic copying and re-derivation on split and merge, including enhancement programs that update collected data each time a shop-floor control number is split.Cavity-level and sub-lot data: carrying mold, machine and cavity identity onto batch characteristics and onto planned/production orders via custom fields, and surfacing it on travelers, labels and packing documents.Traceability reporting: building forward/backward genealogy queries over batch data with CDS, integrating with the Batch Information Cockpit and Global Batch Traceability rather than rebuilding them.Interfaces that carry batch identity - SFC-to-batch one-to-one mapping with the digital manufacturing layer, vendor batch capture, batch data on delivery documents - and the handling of long (up to 40-digit) lot numbers through splits, an open design decision on this program. Required Qualifications 6+ years SAP technical development with 3+ full-lifecycle implementations, including at least 1 on S/4HANA.Strong ABAP OO and ABAP on HANA: CDS views, AMDP, code pushdown and performance optimization; hands-on RAP and modern extensibility (key-user and developer extensibility, released APIs, BAdIs).Demonstrable clean-core delivery: extensions that survive upgrades, and the discipline to refuse core modifications.SAPUI5 / Fiori development including Fiori Elements, annotations, custom controls and launchpad configuration.Hands-on SAP BTP including Integration Suite (Cloud Integration, API Management) and event-based integration; Cloud Foundry or Kyma application development is an advantage.SAP integration technologies: OData, REST, SOAP, IDoc, ALE/EDI, the Data Replication Framework and file-based interfaces; forms and print output (Adobe Forms or SmartForms) for travelers, labels and packing documents.Development against PP, QM and MM/IM/WM with a working functional understanding of what those modules do. Preferred Qualifications Bilingual English/Japanese (business level); prior delivery in Japan, including multi-language UI and print output.Integrating SAP Digital Manufacturing or an MES with S/4HANA, and machine/edge connectivity patterns (OPC UA; bridging non-standard protocols such as CC-Link via middleware or an edge gateway is a distinct advantage).Analytical CDS models consumed by SAP Analytics Cloud or SAP Business Data Cloud.SAP Build Process Automation or SAP Workflow Management.ABAP Test Cockpit, abapGit, gCTS and CI/CD for SAP.SAP certification in ABAP for S/4HANA, Fiori application development, or BTP Integration Suite. Language Requirement - Bilingual English/Japanese Preferred, Not Required Fluent professional English is required for design documentation, deliverables and steering-committee communication. Business-level Japanese is a strong advantage - many process owners, shop-floor personnel and legacy-system custodians work primarily in Japanese, and much current-state documentation exists only in Japanese - but it is not a condition of appointment. Interpretation support, bilingual design documentation and pairing with bilingual business analysts are provided, and strong candidates will be considered regardless of Japanese-language ability. Engagement Details Full-time consulting assignment across the Explore, Realize and Deploy phases. Hybrid delivery with periodic on-site presence at the Japan sites during validation workshops, integration testing, cutover and hypercare. Reports to the workstream lead, working alongside client SMEs, client IT and the corporate global SAP template and clean-core governance teams. Top 4 Job Requirements For This Role Clean-core development discipline - CDS, RAP and released extension points only, with the discipline to refuse core modifications and challenge builds better solved by configuration. SAP BTP Integration Suite - Cloud Integration, API Management and event-based integration to SAP Digital Manufacturing, factory-automation systems and the analytics layer. Fiori and SAPUI5 delivery - Fiori Elements and custom applications, including shop-floor UIs usable on hand-held devices and gloved hands, with Japanese and English support. Batch and lot data expertise - batch classification, the batch number BAdI, characteristic re-derivation on split, and the judgment to resist rebuilding legacy lot logic. title: DCO Front End Developer
description:
**About WPP Production**
 We are WPP Production \- the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world\-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi\-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.
   

  

**About WPP**
 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting\-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world\-class creativity, next\-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 We are looking for a DCO Frontend Developer with a strong foundation in dynamic creative (DCO) implementations to build scalable, high\-performance digital ad experiences across web, display, social, and video environments. This role focuses primarily on frontend engineering, component\-based architecture, performance optimization, and responsive creative development, while also supporting dynamic creative integrations, feed\-driven logic, and campaign activation workflows. You will collaborate closely with creative, media, and product teams to translate design concepts into robust, reusable frontend solutions that power personalized and data\-driven advertising experiences
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Design and develop high\-quality, performant frontend applications and ad creatives using modern web technologies (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript).
* Build and maintain modular, reusable, and scalable creative templates and UI components.
* Ensure cross\-browser, cross\-device compatibility and responsive/adaptive design across all environments.
* Optimize assets for performance, load speed, and runtime efficiency, especially in constrained ad\-serving environments.
* Integrate dynamic data feeds (JSON, XML, CSV, APIs) to enable personalization and content variation.
* Implement and manage basic DCO logic, including creative variations, dynamic content insertion, and conditional rendering.
* Collaborate with designers to translate Figma/Adobe designs into pixel\-perfect, interactive experiences.
* Troubleshoot and debug issues across browsers, devices, and ad platforms.
* Participate in code reviews, version control workflows, and frontend best practices implementation.
* Work with cross\-functional teams (creative, media, production) to ensure smooth delivery and deployment of campaigns.
* Support campaign launches and QA, ensuring accuracy and functionality of dynamic creatives.


**Requirements** 
**:**
* Strong experience in HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6\+).
* Experience building responsive and adaptive UIs across devices and screen sizes.
* Proficiency with JavaScript animation libraries such as GSAP, CreateJS, or similar.
* Familiarity with component\-based architecture and reusable design systems.
* Strong understanding of performance optimization techniques (lazy loading, asset compression, efficient DOM manipulation).
* Experience with cross\-browser compatibility and debugging tools.
* Working knowledge of Git and version control workflows.
* Experience with SASS/SCSS and modern CSS methodologies.
* Familiarity with Figma and design\-to\-development workflows.
* Understanding of web accessibility (WCAG) and W3C standards.


**Nice to Haves:**
* Experience with creative tools such as Adobe Animate, After Effects, Photoshop, or Illustrator.
* Exposure to dynamic ad platforms like Celtra, Innovid, or Smartly.
* Knowledge of video ad formats (VAST/VPAID) and rich media creatives.
* Understanding of programmatic advertising ecosystem fundamentals.
* Familiarity with basic backend/API integration concepts for data\-driven experiences.
* Interest or exposure to AI/automation in frontend or creative workflows.


**Technical Skills**
* Core: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6\+)
* Styling: SASS/SCSS, responsive design
* Animation: GSAP, CreateJS
* Data Handling: JSON, XML, CSV
* Tools: Git, Figma, Adobe Suite
* Standards: WCAG, W3C, cross\-browser compatibility.


**Why work here:**
 At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world\-class talent, cutting\-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next\-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.
   

  

**Inclusion and Impact**
 WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
   

  

**Data**
 We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. When you click the "Submit Application" button at the bottom of this page, this will send all the information you have added to WPP Production. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy statement. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.
   

  

**Please contact careers@wppproduction.com if you need the job advert or form in another format.**

title: Software Architect / Enterprise Frontend & Cloud Architect
description:
**Hello Visionary!**
 At Siemens, we believe businesses thrive when people grow. That’s why we put our people first—empowering them with opportunities, challenges, and continuous learning. Join our global, diverse teams and discover how far your journey can take you.
   

  

 We’re looking for a
 **Fullstack Developer (C\# \+ Angular, 5–8 years)** 
 to join our team in Chennai.
   

  

**You’ll Make a Difference By**
* Designing and developing scalable, cloud\-native applications using C\# (.NET Core), Angular, and AWS
* Building high\-quality, maintainable software within a modern Agile (Scrum) environment
* Collaborating with cross\-functional, global teams to deliver robust solutions
* Contributing to architecture, estimation, planning, and implementation
* Implementing unit tests, integration tests, and supporting test automation
* Leveraging tools like GitLab CI, Docker, Kubernetes to enable continuous integration and deployment
* Developing solutions for energy monitoring and optimization platforms, including real\-time and historical data visualization
* Ensuring clean code, scalability, and long\-term maintainability
* Driving continuous improvement and adhering to Siemens development processes


**You’ll Win Us Over By**
**Education \& Experience**
* B.E. / B.Tech / M.Sc. / MCA in Computer Science or Information Technology (or equivalent)
* 5\+ years of IT experience, including:
+ At least 3 years in cloud\-native development
+ Hands\-on experience with C\# (.NET Core), Angular, and AWS.


**Must\-Have Skills**
* Strong object\-oriented programming (OOP) and ability to translate requirements into scalable solutions
* Experience writing unit and integration tests
* Hands\-on experience with GitLab CI and Docker
* Solid understanding of containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud platforms (AWS)
* Experience with development tools such as Visual Studio Code, IntelliJ, or Eclipse
* Strong communication skills (written \& spoken English)
* Ownership mindset with a commitment to quality and engineering excellence
* Eagerness to learn and work with additional technologies like Python, Go, or similar.


**Desirable Skills**
* Experience with AWS services such as Lambda, DynamoDB, API Gateway, SNS/SQS, CloudWatch, Serverless architectures
* Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)
* Familiarity with tools like Git, SonarQube
* Experience in Agile methodologies (Scrum ceremonies, clean code practices, self\-organized teams)
* Exposure to TDD, test\-first development, refactoring, and profiling
* Experience working with international and virtual teams
* Certifications in C\#, Angular, Go, or Python


**What You’ll Gain**
 Opportunity to work on
 **cutting\-edge cloud solutions** 
 impacting energy efficiency and sustainability
   

  

* Exposure to global product teams and engineering best practices
* A structured SAFe Agile environment promoting collaboration and innovation
* A culture that values ownership, diversity, and continuous growth


**Create a better \#TomorrowWithUs!**
 This role, based in Chennai, is an individual contributor position. You may be required to visit other locations within India and internationally. In return, you'll have the opportunity to work with teams shaping the future.
   

  

 At Siemens, we are a collection of over 312,000 minds building the future, one day at a time, worldwide. We are dedicated to equality and welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we serve. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.
   

  

 Bring your curiosity and imagination, and help us shape tomorrow
   

  

 Find out more about Siemens careers at: www.siemens.com/careers \#STS
